Why Choose hi! by Singtel?

hi! by Singtel offers affordable, flexible mobile plans on Singapore's trusted Singtel 5G+ network.

 

Whether you're looking for a reliable everyday plan, extra data, travel roaming or an easy-to-manage SIM, hi! gives you the freedom to stay connected without long-term commitments.

 

Enjoy:

Generous data allowances
5G+ connectivity
Regional roaming included on selected plans
Easy eSIM activation
No long-term contracts
Great value for everyday use

 

Perfect for students, working adults, travellers and anyone who wants flexibility without compromising on network quality.

FAQ

hi! by Singtel offers affordable, no-contract 30-day mobile plans on Singtel's reliable network. Plans include large data bundles, local calls, SMS, roaming data and IDD minutes. Choose from eSIM or SIM options for everyday use, travel or overseas calls. Eligible seniors can also enjoy a lower-priced plan.

Yes. Selected hi! mobile plans include roaming data. Depending on your plan, you can use your data in destinations such as Malaysia, ASEAN, APAC or selected worldwide countries. Check your plan details for included destinations, roaming data and validity before you buy.

To get a hi! plan, you’ll need to fulfil these requirements: 

 

  1. Be 16 years or older 

  2. Have a Singpass account or any of the these ID documents to sign up:

    Singapore NRIC / 11B
    Employment Pass
    S Pass
    Work Permit
    Dependent Pass
    Student Pass
    Social Visit Pass

hi! Senior plan is only available to all Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents, Employment and Long-Term Pass holders aged 60 years old and above.

 

Your hi! Senior Plan details will be available in the hi! app on the following day after sign-up.

Yes. Make sure of the following:

  1. Your current number must be an active postpaid line registered under your NRIC/FIN. If not, please contact your telco to transfer ownership of the line to yourself.

  2. Your current postpaid line must be active with no outstanding payments to your telco.

Simply set up your PIN and biometrics login (FaceID) as per guide here.

Unused local data, roaming data, calls, and SMS can be carried forward when you top up your hi! Plan before it expires. Your unused benefits will be automatically rolled over and stacked for up to 6 months. Customers on Auto-Recurring plans are also eligible to enjoy this rollover feature.


You can request an eSIM replacement through the hi! App by following these steps:​

​

Log in to the Singtel hi! App ​

Go to Me ​

Select Request New SIM ​

Choose your number for the eSIM replacement request ​

Follow the on-screen instructions ​

 

Alternatively, you may visit any hi! Retailers for assistance.

Click here to view the roaming destinations for each hi! Plan.

Your hi!Rewards tier is determined by your total spending on eligible hi! plans within each calendar month. Your tier is refreshed monthly based on your spending for that month.

From 17 Aug 2026, you can get an eligible hi! by Singtel plan online at singtel.com/hi and choose a physical SIM at checkout. Once you receive your order confirmation email, visit any participating hi! retailer during operating hours to collect your SIM card.

SIM card collection is available for:

•         New sign-ups for hi! plans

•         Port-ins to hi! plans

All plans must be purchased online via singtel.com/hi.

Collect your SIM card within 30 days of your purchase date. If your SIM card is not collected within 30 days, your order will be forfeited, and no refund will be provided.

Yes, SIM card collection is free for all eligible hi! by Singtel plans. There are no additional fees.

You can collect your SIM card from any participating hi! retailer that’s convenient for you. You don’t need to select a collection outlet during purchase. View the full list of hi! retailer locations. 

Once you have received your order confirmation email, your SIM card is ready for collection. Visit any participating hi! retailer during operating hours to pick it up.

First, check your junk or spam folder. Still can't find it? Contact Chat Support and we'll help you out.

You have to bring:

•         Your order confirmation email

•         Your mobile phone with Singpass for easier registration

Alternatively, you can bring a valid Singapore-issued ID e.g. NRIC, Employment Pass (EP), S Pass or Work Permit.

 

For identity verification, you need to collect your SIM card in person. Someone else can't collect it on your behalf. 

No, all purchases are final once your order is successfully placed, so we won’t be able to provide a refund. Do check your order details before completing your purchase.

FAQ
1. What is hi! by Singtel?
hi! by Singtel offers affordable, no-contract 30-day mobile plans on Singtel's reliable network. Plans include large data bundles, local calls, SMS, roaming data and IDD minutes. Choose from eSIM or SIM options for everyday use, travel or overseas calls. Eligible seniors can also enjoy a lower-priced plan.
2. Can I use hi! mobile plans overseas?
Yes. Selected hi! mobile plans include roaming data. Depending on your plan, you can use your data in destinations such as Malaysia, ASEAN, APAC or selected worldwide countries. Check your plan details for included destinations, roaming data and validity before you buy.
3. How do I sign up for hi! Plan?
To get a hi! plan, you’ll need to fulfil these requirements:
Be 16 years or older
Have a Singpass account or any of the these ID documents to sign up:
Singapore NRIC / 11B
Employment Pass
S Pass
Work Permit
Dependent Pass
Student Pass
Social Visit Pass
4. What is the hi! Senior Plan?
hi! Senior plan is only available to all Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents, Employment and Long-Term Pass holders aged 60 years old and above.
Your hi! Senior Plan details will be available in the hi! app on the following day after sign-up.
5. Can I transfer my existing number to hi! Plan?
Yes. Make sure of the following:
Your current number must be an active postpaid line registered under your NRIC/FIN. If not, please contact your telco to transfer ownership of the line to yourself.
Your current postpaid line must be active with no outstanding payments to your telco.
6. How do I setup the Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) on the hi! App?
Simply set up your PIN and biometrics login (FaceID) as per guide
here
.
7. Can I rollover my unused data, calls, and SMS?
Unused local data, roaming data, calls, and SMS can be carried forward when you top up your hi! Plan before it expires. Your unused benefits will be automatically rolled over and stacked for up to 6 months. Customers on Auto-Recurring plans are also eligible to enjoy this rollover feature.
8. What should I do if I need to replace my eSIM (e.g. due to phone change, loss, or damage)?
You can request an eSIM replacement through the hi! App by following these steps:​
​
Log in to the
Singtel hi! App
​
Go to Me ​
Select Request New SIM ​
Choose your number for the eSIM replacement request ​
Follow the on-screen instructions ​
Alternatively, you may visit any
hi! Retailers
for assistance.
9. What roaming destinations are covered under the hi! Plan?
Click
here
to view the roaming destinations for each hi! Plan.
10. How do I qualify for hi!Rewards?
Your hi!Rewards tier is determined by your total spending on eligible hi! plans within each calendar month. Your tier is refreshed monthly based on your spending for that month.
11. What is SIM card collection?
From 17 Aug 2026, you can get an eligible hi! by Singtel plan online at singtel.com/hi and choose a physical SIM at checkout. Once you receive your order confirmation email, visit any
participating hi! retailer
during operating hours to collect your SIM card.
12. Which plans are eligible for SIM card collection?
SIM card collection is available for:
• New sign-ups for hi! plans
• Port-ins to hi! plans
All plans must be purchased online via
singtel.com/hi
.
13. How long do I have to collect my SIM card?
Collect your SIM card
within 30 days
of your purchase date. If your SIM card is not collected within 30 days,
your order will be forfeited, and no refund will be provided
.
14. Is SIM card collection free?
Yes, SIM card collection is
free
for all eligible hi! by Singtel plans. There are no additional fees.
15. Where can I collect my SIM card?
You can collect your SIM card from
any participating hi! retailer
that’s convenient for you. You don’t need to select a collection outlet during purchase.
View the full list of hi! retailer locations
.
16. How will I know when my SIM card is ready for collection?
Once you have received your order confirmation email, your SIM card is ready for collection. Visit any
participating hi! retailer
during operating hours to pick it up.
17. I didn't receive my order confirmation email. What should I do?
First, check your junk or spam folder. Still can't find it? Contact
Chat Support
and we'll help you out.
18. What do I need to bring when collecting my SIM card?
You have to bring:
• Your
order confirmation email
• Your
mobile phone with Singpass
for easier registration
Alternatively, you can bring a valid
Singapore-issued ID
e.g. NRIC, Employment Pass (EP), S Pass or Work Permit.
For identity verification,
you need to collect your SIM card in person
. Someone else can't collect it on your behalf.
19. Can I get a refund after purchasing my plan?
No, all purchases are final once your order is successfully placed, so
we won’t be able to provide a refund
. Do check your order details before completing your purchase.
